title: Measuring What Matters
subtitle: Our goal is not simply to say that we volunteered.
intro: We want to understand and document what changed because students participated.
track_lead: Throughout the year, we will track:
track_note: When organizations provide requested-item lists, we can also measure how closely our collections match their actual needs.
improve_lead: After major initiatives, club leaders will evaluate:
evaluate: What did our community partner actually need?
What measurable impact did the project have?
What should we change next time?
improve_note: This allows each project to improve on the one before it.
updates_intro: As projects are completed, this page can display:
updates_note: Each completed project will also include photos and a short explanation of the need addressed and the club's contribution.
